## Calculation of taxonomic and functional alpha-diversity

## Load packages and functions
```{r}
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(lmerTest)
library(lme4)
```


# Rarefy abundance data to minimum sequencing depth

```{r}
design <- read.csv("Metadata.csv", row.names=1, header = T)
head(design)
# It is recommended to perform smoothing analysis using integer abundance data.
spe1 <- read.csv("KOs.count.csv", row.names=1, header = T)
spe1 <- read.csv("Species.count.csv", row.names=1, header = T)
spe1[1:5,1:5]
spe <- t(spe1[,rownames(design)]) %>% as.data.frame()
spe <- spe[,colSums(spe)>0]

# Observed species
S.obs <- function(x = ""){
  rowSums(x > 0) * 1
}

spe.S <- S.obs(spe)
min.N <- min(rowSums(spe))  
spe.int <- round(spe, 0)

# Rarefaction
rarefied <- rrarefy(spe.int, sample = min.N) 
rowSums(rarefied)
rarecurve(x = rarefied, step = 100, col = "blue", cex = 0.6, las = 1)
abline(0, 1, col = 'red')             
text(1500, 1500, "1:1", pos = 2, col = 'red')
write.csv(rarefied, file = "Species.count_rarefied.csv")
write.csv(rarefied, file = "KOs.count_rarefied.csv")
```


# Calculation of taxonomic alpha-diversity using rarefied abundance data

```{r}
# Import data
design <- read.csv("Metadata.csv",row.names=1) 
spe_trans <- read.csv("Species.count_rarefied.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)

# Shannon
Shannon <- diversity(spe_trans) 
Shannon
#write.csv(as.data.frame(Shannon), file="Shannon_rare_species.csv")

# Within-group mean
tapply(Shannon, design$Irrigation, mean)
t.test(Shannon ~ Irrigation, data = design, var.equal = F)
wilcox.test(Shannon ~ Irrigation, data = design)
anova(lmer(Shannon ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design))


# Simpson
Inv_Simpson <- diversity(spe_trans, "inv")
Inv_Simpson

tapply(Inv_Simpson, design$Irrigation, mean)
t.test(Inv_Simpson ~ Irrigation, data = design, var.equal = F)
wilcox.test(Inv_Simpson ~ Irrigation, data = design)
anova(lmer(Inv_Simpson ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design))


# Richness
S <- specnumber(spe_trans)
S

tapply(S, design$Irrigation, mean)
t.test(S ~ Irrigation, data = design, var.equal = F) 
wilcox.test(S ~ Irrigation, data = design)
anova(lmer(S ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design))


# Pielou_evenness
Pielou_evenness <- Shannon/log(S)
Pielou_evenness

tapply(Pielou_evenness, design$Irrigation, mean) 
t.test(Pielou_evenness ~ Irrigation, data = design, var.equal = F) 
wilcox.test(Pielou_evenness ~ Irrigation, data = design)
anova(lmer(Pielou_evenness ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design))


# Simpson_evenness
Simpson_evenness <- Inv_Simpson/S
Simpson_evenness

tapply(Simpson_evenness, design$Irrigation, mean) 
t.test(Simpson_evenness ~ Irrigation, data = design)    
wilcox.test(Simpson_evenness ~ Irrigation, data = design) 
anova(lmer(Simpson_evenness ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design)) 


# Export data
report = cbind(Shannon, Inv_Simpson, S, Pielou_evenness, Simpson_evenness)
head(report)
write.csv(report, file = "Species_alpha_diveristy_Rarefied.csv")
```


# Calculation of functional alpha-diversity using rarefied abundance data

```{r}
# Import data
design <- read.csv("Metadata.csv",row.names=1) 
spe_trans <- read.csv("KOs.count_rarefied.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)

# Shannon
Shannon <- diversity(spe_trans) 
Shannon
#write.csv(as.data.frame(Shannon), file="Shannon_rare_species.csv")

# Within-group mean
tapply(Shannon, design$Irrigation, mean)
t.test(Shannon ~ Irrigation, data = design, var.equal = F)
wilcox.test(Shannon ~ Irrigation, data = design)
anova(lmer(Shannon ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design))


# Simpson
Inv_Simpson <- diversity(spe_trans, "inv")
Inv_Simpson

tapply(Inv_Simpson, design$Irrigation, mean)
t.test(Inv_Simpson ~ Irrigation, data = design, var.equal = F)
wilcox.test(Inv_Simpson ~ Irrigation, data = design)
anova(lmer(Inv_Simpson ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design))


# Richness
S <- specnumber(spe_trans)
S

tapply(S, design$Irrigation, mean)
t.test(S ~ Irrigation, data = design, var.equal = F) 
wilcox.test(S ~ Irrigation, data = design)
anova(lmer(S ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design))


# Pielou_evenness
Pielou_evenness <- Shannon/log(S)
Pielou_evenness

tapply(Pielou_evenness, design$Irrigation, mean) 
t.test(Pielou_evenness ~ Irrigation, data = design, var.equal = F) 
wilcox.test(Pielou_evenness ~ Irrigation, data = design)
anova(lmer(Pielou_evenness ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design))


# Simpson_evenness
Simpson_evenness <- Inv_Simpson/S
Simpson_evenness

tapply(Simpson_evenness, design$Irrigation, mean) 
t.test(Simpson_evenness ~ Irrigation, data = design)    
wilcox.test(Simpson_evenness ~ Irrigation, data = design) 
anova(lmer(Simpson_evenness ~ Irrigation + (1|State), data = design)) 


# Export data
report = cbind(Shannon, Inv_Simpson, S, Pielou_evenness, Simpson_evenness)
head(report)
write.csv(report, file = "KOs_alpha_diveristy_Rarefied.csv")
```
